rows.Kwic: 銀碗裏盛雪也好，秤錘裏掜汁也好，破沙盆裏煬羹也好

Override.AttributionNote: 嵩山野竹禪師語錄, winter-solstice hall address requested by Yang Wengu. Yezhu Fusheng is the exact speaker: he lists 'snow heaped in a silver bowl' among four expressions he will set aside before asking who the heart of heaven is.
